Key features of this Ram 2500 Limited include:

- Night Edition styling with 20 cast aluminum black wheels and black exterior accents

The digital rearview mirror adapts to changing light conditions, and the ParkView rear backup camera assists with parking and reversing.

The exterior Night Edition package delivers aggressive styling that turns heads and separates this truck from the crowd. Black headlamp bezels, black exterior mirrors, black grille, and black wheel center hubs create a cohesive, premium appearance. Painted front and rear bumpers, body color door handles, and tow hooks complete the aggressive look while adding practical functionality.

Every aspect of this 2022 Ram 2500 Limited reflects thoughtful engineering and attention to detail. Whether you're using this truck for work or enjoying it as a refined daily driver, the combination of diesel power, advanced safety technology, and luxury amenities creates a compelling package. This truck is ready to handle whatever you need while providing the comfort and technology features that make every mile more enjoyable.

- 4.4L V8 Twin Turbocharged Engine with 8-Speed Automatic Sport Transmission and AWD
- Driving Assistance Professional Package with hands-off driving up to 85mph, Automatic Lane Change, and cross-traffic alert front
- M Sport Professional Package including M Sport Brakes with Red Calipers and M Shadowline Lights
- Panoramic Sky Lounge LED Roof with power moonroof capability
- Executive Package with Soft-Close Automatic Doors and Glass Controls
- Parking Assistance Package with Surround View and 3D View
- Climate Comfort Package with 4-Zone Automatic Climate Control, Front & Rear Heated Seats, and Heated Steering Wheel
- Navigation System with Live Cockpit Pro and ConnectedDrive Services
- harman/kardon Surround Sound System with 16 Speakers and SiriusXM 360L
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Compatibility with Wireless Device Charging
- Gesture Control and Head-Up Display
- 20 M Star-Spoke Bi-Colored Alloy Wheels
- Multi-Contour Seats with Front Ventilated Seats and Power Front Seats
- Trailer Hitch for towing capability
- Extended Shadowline Trim with Heated Door Mirrors and Auto-Dimming Door Mirrors

The powertrain delivers capable performance with EPA ratings of 17 city and 22 highway mpg, providing a balanced blend of efficiency for everyday driving. The 4.4L V8 Twin Turbocharged engine pairs with the 8-Speed Automatic Sport transmission and all-wheel drive to ensure responsive handling across varying road conditions. AWD technology delivers enhanced traction and stability whether navigating urban streets or highway travel.

Technology plays a central role in the X5 M60i experience. The Driving Assistance Professional Package provides advanced capabilities including adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go functionality, lane-keeping assistance with collision avoidance, and highway assistance that supports hands-off driving up to 85mph. Active Park Distance Control and the Surround View system with 3D visualization simplify parking in tight spaces. Live Cockpit Pro delivers integrated navigation with real-time connectivity through ConnectedDrive Services and Personal eSIM 5G capability.

Comfort and convenience features are designed to enhance every journey. The Climate Comfort Package includes a 4-Zone Automatic Climate Control system that allows independent temperature management for different passenger zones, along with heated front and rear seats plus a heated steering wheel. The Executive Package adds touches like Soft-Close Automatic Doors and Glass Controls, while the Panoramic Sky Lounge LED Roof creates an open, airy cabin environment. Multi-Contour Seats with power adjustment and ventilation ensure long-distance comfort.

The M Sport Professional Package elevates the visual and performance character. M Sport Brakes with Red Calipers provide stopping power and distinctive styling, while M Shadowline Lights and Extended Shadowline Trim elements accentuate the vehicle's athletic stance. The 20 M Star-Spoke Bi-Color alloy wheels complete the premium appearance.

This 2024 BMW X5 M60i represents a comprehensive luxury SUV solution with proven performance capabilities, intelligent technology, and refined comfort features working in concert. We invite you to schedule a visit to experience firsthand how this vehicle can meet your expectations for a premium driving platform.

The 2024 Chevrolet Traverse Z71 is a midsize SUV designed to balance modern capability with proven ownership value. Finished in Mosaic Black Metallic and featuring a Jet Black interior with Torch Red accents, this all-wheel drive vehicle shows just 15,775 miles and boasts a one-owner history.

Shoppers researching a dependable SUV for Midwest weather or growing families will find the Traverse Z71 especially compelling. With all-wheel drive, heated seats, and a heated steering wheel, it's well-suited for variable climates and year-round use, including snowy Iowa winters. Split-bench power-folding third-row seats allow for flexible cargo or passenger configurations, making daily errands or road trips easier. The one-owner pedigree and relatively low mileage further enhance its appeal to drivers who value a trustworthy pre-owned vehicle for their long-term needs.

The Traverse Z71's 2.5L DOHC engine and 8-speed automatic transmission are engineered for smooth, responsive power delivery in both city and highway driving. All-wheel drive enhances traction on slippery roads, providing stable handling during rain or snow. The SUV's four-wheel independent suspension and electronic stability control contribute to a composed, comfortable ride, while adaptive cruise control and speed-sensing steering reduce driver fatigue on longer trips. The engine and drivetrain combination delivers a balance of efficiency and capability for everyday use, commuting, or family outings.

Active safety is a highlight of this SUV, with systems like Lane Keep Assist helping to prevent unintentional lane departure and Blind Spot Monitoring alerting drivers to vehicles in adjacent lanes. The 360 Degree Camera and Reverse Sensing provide a clear view around the vehicle and assist with parking or backing out of tight spots. ABS brakes, traction control, and brake assist work together to help maintain control during sudden stops or challenging road conditions. Dual front and side impact airbags, along with an emergency communication system, add important layers of occupant protection.

Key features in the Z71 trim include heated front seats, power-folding third-row seats, dual-zone climate control for passenger comfort, and a heated steering wheel for cold mornings. The SUV is equipped with a 12-speaker audio system and a 17.7-inch diagonal display that supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, making it easy to connect smartphones and stream media. Navigation, remote keyless entry, and a power liftgate further enhance everyday convenience. Premium cloth seat trim and thoughtful touches like steering wheel-mounted audio controls round out the interior experience.

When compared to other midsize SUVs such as the Ford Explorer and Honda Pilot, the Traverse Z71 stands out for its combination of advanced safety technology, flexible seating, and one-owner history.

What are the key features of this SUV? It includes heated seats, adaptive cruise, blind spot monitoring, a power liftgate, navigation, and a large touchscreen with smartphone integration. How does it perform in daily driving? The engine and AWD system deliver smooth performance and reliable traction in most conditions. What safety systems are included? Lane Keep Assist, Blind Spot Monitoring, a 360 Degree Camera, and ABS brakes are all present.

To experience the 2024 Chevrolet Traverse Z71 in person, visit Lynch Ford Chevrolet at 410 Business 30 Sw Mt Vernon, IA 52314 or call . Their knowledgeable team can provide detailed information and arrange a no-pressure test drive tailored to your needs.

The 2027 Chevrolet Equinox RS delivers a refined driving experience designed for those who value comfort, technology, and reliability in a capable crossover.

- Convenience Package III with 8-way power front passenger seat adjuster
- Ventilated driver and front passenger seats
- Heated rear outboard seats
- Front passenger 2-way power lumbar seat adjuster with memory settings
- Heated steering wheel
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system with 11.3" advanced color touchscreen
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and wireless Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L trial subscription
- Navigation system with 5G vehicle connectivity
- OnStar emergency communication and connected services
- Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off feature
- 19" carbon flash metallic aluminum wheels
- Automatic temperature control with front dual-zone capability

This Gray RS comes equipped with practical features that enhance your daily commute and longer journeys alike. The cabin welcomes you with premium seating surfaces and multiple comfort adjustments, ensuring every occupant finds their ideal position. The ventilated front seats and heated rear outboard seats adapt to seasonal changes, while the heated steering wheel adds another layer of convenience during colder months.

Technology integration is seamless through the advanced infotainment system, offering intuitive connectivity with your smartphone via wireless CarPlay and Android Auto. Navigation and real-time information arrive through the prominent touchscreen display, complemented by SiriusXM's expanded radio options. The 5G connectivity keeps you informed and connected throughout your travels, while OnStar services provide peace of mind.

Performance combines efficiency with capability through the 1.5L DOHC engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, delivering 25 city and 29 highway MPG. The front-wheel drive configuration provides confident handling, supported by four-wheel independent suspension and electronic stability control. Speed-sensing steering and responsive braking systems work together to keep you in command of the road.

Safety features are comprehensive, including dual front and side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and an occupant sensing system. Traction control and brake assist systems support confident vehicle operation in varied conditions. The low tire pressure warning system monitors your wheels, while emergency communication capabilities connect you to assistance when needed.

The Equinox RS presents a well-rounded package for buyers seeking a modern crossover with attentive comfort features, practical technology, and dependable performance. Visit our showroom to experience the quality and thoughtful design this vehicle offers firsthand.

- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Heated and Cooled Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- High Tech Navigation System
- Trailer Tow Package with Integrated Trailer Brake Controller
- Z71 Off-Road & Protection Package
- Premium Bose Audio System

Built on the proven platform of Chevrolet's truck legacy, this Silverado 1500 LTZ is powered by the EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive. The combination delivers the torque needed for towing and hauling while maintaining reasonable fuel efficiency at 16 city and 22 highway MPG. With 89,019 miles on the odometer, this truck has proven reliability and is backed by a comprehensive 172-point inspection.

The LTZ trim elevates your experience with premium features throughout the cabin. Heated and cooled front seats keep you comfortable in any season, while the heated steering wheel adds convenience during cold weather. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system with premium Bose audio and an 8-inch touchscreen ensures you stay connected with seamless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration. Navigation simplifies route planning, and wireless charging keeps your devices powered during your drives.

This truck's gray exterior gives it a modern, professional appearance that suits any setting. The Z71 Off-Road & Protection Package includes off-road suspension, skid plates, and a high-capacity air filter, while the spray-on bed liner protects the truck bed from damage. Twenty-inch polished wheels dressed in all-terrain tires provide both visual appeal and capable traction. Chrome accents, including the grille and mirror caps, add polish to the exterior.

For those who regularly tow, the Trailer Tow Package makes a real difference. The advanced trailering system incorporates an integrated trailer brake controller, hitch guidance with hitch view, and a tire pressure monitor for the trailer all working together to make towing safer and more controlled. Front frame-mounted recovery hooks round out the truck's capability.

Inside, the cabin reflects the LTZ's commitment to quality. Ten-way power driver and passenger seats with lumbar support provide personalized comfort for long drives. The available rear sliding power window with defroster enhances practicality, while the power tailgate with easy up-and-down operation saves effort. The black accent package gives this Expedition Max a distinctive appearance with gloss black painted bumper skid plates, 20-inch gloss black wheels wrapped in all-terrain tires, and a matching trailer hitch cover. Chrome platform running boards add both style and utility, making entry and exit easier while enhancing the vehicle's presence on the road.

Built to handle Michigan winters and summer road trips alike, this Expedition Max offers the dependable engineering Ford owners trust. With 82,833 miles on the odometer, this well-maintained example is ready to serve you reliably for years to come. The electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain grip in challenging driving conditions, while the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about your vehicle's health. OnStar connected services provide emergency assistance and additional peace of mind.

The exterior combines practicality with style, featuring body-color bumpers, a spoiler, and 17-inch Grazen Metallic Machined-Face aluminum wheels that give the crossover a polished appearance. Heated door mirrors with power adjustment ensure clear visibility in any weather, and the fully automatic headlights with auto high-beam functionality enhance safety during night driving. The rear window wiper and variably intermittent front wipers handle precipitation effectively.

This 2027 Chevrolet Equinox LT represents a well-rounded package for those seeking dependable transportation with modern conveniences and safety features. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience firsthand how this crossover can meet your everyday needs.

This 2017 Honda Pilot Elite in white offers a capable and well-equipped three-row SUV built for families and active drivers who value both practicality and comfort.

- 10-speaker premium audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System with Honda smartphone integration
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with perforated leather trim
- Power moonroof for enhanced cabin openness
- Heated steering wheel for comfort in cold weather
- Three-row seating with split-folding rear seats for flexible cargo space
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone and rear air conditioning
- HomeLink garage door transmitter for seamless home integration
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone connectivity
- Exterior rearview camera for convenient backing assistance
- Four-wheel independent suspension for smooth handling
- 20-inch alloy wheels on a durable AWD platform
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Six standard airbags including overhead protection
- HondaLink Assist emergency communication system

The 3.5-liter V6 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission delivers balanced performance while achieving 19 miles per gallon in the city and 26 on the highway. All-wheel drive provides confidence in various weather conditions, and the speed-sensing power steering adjusts effort based on vehicle speed for better control both in parking and at highway speeds.

Inside, the elite appointments reflect Honda's attention to detail. Heated and ventilated front seats keep occupants comfortable throughout the seasons, while automatic climate zones ensure all three rows maintain their preferred temperatures. The heated steering wheel provides additional warmth during winter drives, and the power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light. Memory seating lets the driver save preferred positions for easier entries.

Technology integration extends throughout the cabin with steering wheel-mounted audio controls, rear audio controls for back-seat passengers, and full smartphone mirroring through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The navigation system works seamlessly with satellite-linked maps, and HomeLink compatibility means you can operate your garage door directly from the vehicle.

Safety features are comprehensive, including four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction management working together to help maintain vehicle control. The high-strength frame incorporates dual front and side impact airbags plus overhead protection across all three rows, complemented by the HondaLink Assist emergency communication system.

With its combination of three-row versatility, premium comfort features, advanced safety technologies, and reliable all-wheel-drive performance, this 2017 Honda Pilot Elite is ready to serve active families. We invite you to schedule a test drive and discover why the Pilot remains a trusted choice for drivers seeking dependable transportation.

This 2016 Lexus NX 200t represents an accessible entry point into luxury compact crossover ownership. This 2019 Buick Encore Preferred combines practical design with thoughtful features that make everyday driving more convenient. With 53,937 miles on the odometer, this gray compact SUV remains well-maintained and ready for years of reliable service. The comprehensive airbag system, including dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags, works alongside electronic braking technologies like four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and brake assist. The Side Blind Zone Alert and Rear Cross Traffic Alert provide additional awareness when navigating tight spaces or reversing. Emergency communication through OnStar connects you to support when needed.

Practical conveniences enhance daily ownership. The 120-volt power outlet adds flexibility for powering devices, while the rear window defroster and heated door mirrors address seasonal challenges. Remote keyless entry and the remote vehicle starter system allow you to adjust your vehicle's settings from a distance, and the fully automatic headlights adjust to changing light conditions without intervention.

This vehicle has undergone a thorough 62 Point Inspection, providing you with peace of mind. Additionally, it comes with a Vehicle History report and a Powertrain Limited Warranty for 1 Month/1,000 Miles. Safety features demonstrate Chevrolet's commitment to protection. Dual front impact airbags and side impact airbags work alongside occupant sensing technology. OnStar connectivity ensures emergency assistance is always available. Standard features like brake assist and low tire pressure warning keep you informed and protected.

This Equinox LT is ready to serve your daily needs with dependable engineering and practical appointments. Visit us to experience the comfortable, capable driving this vehicle provides.
